svg.title: Sherline lathe + 8760 driver box individual-conductor retrofit diagram
svg.desc: Exact controller, interface, driver, supply and machine terminal labels are joined by separate conductors. Dotted routes are proposed unverified guesses. OPEN breaks identify the missing connection. Numbering is logical, not a mating-face view.

text.tspan: Sherline lathe + 8760 driver box · individual conductor plan

svg.text: Dotted = GUESS / proposed conversion, verify before energizing · Green = retained source path · Broken = OPEN
Each circle is one named physical pin, terminal or identified lead. Connector orientation and fitted revision must match.
Crossing lines are not junctions. Connections exist only at the named terminal circles and explicitly shared nets.

text.tspan: X and Z commands · each buffer input and output pin
Core P1 · X / Z lathe mapping

svg.text: New 3.3 V to 5 V buffer proposal. Confirm actual receiver load fits AHCT output, active-low STEP and low pulses at least 22
µs; verify pin 1 orientation and X/Z firmware assignment.

text.tspan: Inactive STEP at reset · two 10 kΩ pull-ups

svg.text: Proposed inactive-high STEP bias. Configure inverted pulses at least 22 µs and prove reset/startup behaviour at the loaded
DB25 before enabling motion. A pull-up cannot correct a firmware output actively driven low.

text.tspan: Buffer power, decoupling and each output-enable

svg.text: Core J42.1/+5V and J42.2/GND are supplied separately from the same verified logic distribution. Core J5 GND must share the
buffer signal reference. Do not feed the driver-box 24 V motor supply into the logic rail. The buffer is not galvanic

text.tspan: Core power and each DB25 ground return

svg.text: Trace individual cavities and bond verified signal returns; motor currents must not flow through Core.

text.tspan: Retained driver-box motor cables and independent stop

svg.text: Leave the matched X and Z motor DIN cables and 24 V/4 A supply connected to the 8760. No Core pin connects to a motor phase
in this conversion. Inspect H3 panic-stop and RESET; their header cavity numbers are not published. This is an unchanged
cable instruction, not an invented motor pin map.
Read the exact per-wire schedule, full contact inventory, parts, configuration and source checks in the accompanying profile.
